newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Trading in Sang-A shrs to resume Friday.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Sang-A shrs to resume Friday.

text.p: Trading in shares of Sang-A Pharmaceutical Co will resume on Friday following the company's application for court receivership on Wednesday, the Korea Stock Exchange said.
Trading of the shares was suspended on Friday after its affiliate, Hanbo Steel Co defaulted on debt repayments.
An exchange statement said Sang-A Pharmaceutical would be placed under the exchange's "watch list".
The list is designed to protect investors from possible damages from investing in a company faced with managerial difficulties.
A Hanbo Group spokesman said Sang-A and its unlisted unit Hanbo Energy Co filed on Wednesday for court receivership. Hanbo Steel applied for court protection on Tuesday.
Sang-A shares last traded at 11,500 won.
